user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I’ve been trying to send a picture message to my daughter, but it just won’t go through. I’m not very good with these things, so I’m hoping you can help me fix it.

I can help you with that. To assist you better, I need to identify your account first. Could you please provide me with your phone number or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check the settings related to your messaging service.

For verification and accurate lookup, I will need your date of birth along with your full name. Could you please provide your date of birth?
Of course, my date of birth is March 14, 1960. Let me know if you need anything else.

I could not find an account with the name John Smith and the date of birth March 14, 1960. Could you please double-check the information you provided or alternatively provide the phone number again for me to look up your account?
Oh dear, I’m sorry if I made a mistake. My phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that helps you find my account. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Thank you for the information. I found your account under the name John Smith with a date of birth different from the one you initially provided. To proceed with troubleshooting your picture messaging issue, I will need to check some settings on your phone. 

First, I will check if your phone can send MMS messages. Please hold on a moment.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.

To troubleshoot the picture messaging issue, I will need to check the following on your phone:
- Network status and signal strength
- Mobile data status
- APN settings for MMS
- Wi-Fi Calling status
- Permissions for the messaging app

It looks like my phone is in Airplane Mode, and I don’t have any signal or connection right now. Could that be why I can’t send picture messages? What should I do next?

Yes, being in Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service and mobile data, which would prevent you from sending picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you have done that, let me know, and we can continue troubleshooting if needed.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

2. I will check your SIM card status remotely to see if there are any issues.

Yes, if your phone says there is no SIM card detected, that is why you cannot send picture messages or have cellular service. The SIM card is necessary for your phone to connect to the cellular network.

Please try the following:
- Power off your phone.
- Remove the SIM card carefully.
- Reinsert the SIM card properly, making sure it is seated correctly.
- Power your phone back on.

After doing this, check if the SIM card is detected and if you have cellular service. Let me know the result.
